base.name: Investor Pipeline
base.description: VC deal flow CRM — enriched contacts, outreach tracking, and pipeline stage management.

tables.name: Contacts
tables.description: All enriched investor contacts with outreach status and pipeline stage.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Full name of the investor or contact.

fields.name: Firm
fields.description: Venture firm, family office, or organization name.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Contact's professional title (e.g. General Partner, Managing Director, Principal).

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Primary email address — verified via Hunter.io before outreach.

fields.name: Industry
fields.description: Primary investment vertical or industry focus.

fields.name: Stage
fields.description: Current stage in the outreach pipeline.

fields.name: Email Verified
fields.description: True if Hunter.io confirmed email as deliverable.

fields.name: Enriched
fields.description: True if Apollo.io enrichment was successful (title, firm, industry pulled).

fields.name: Outreach Sent
fields.description: True if the Claude-personalized outreach message has been sent.

fields.name: Last Activity
fields.description: Date of most recent activity (enrichment, outreach, reply, meeting).

fields.name: Claude Message
fields.description: Personalized outreach message generated by Claude API. Review before sending.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-form notes: call notes, meeting outcomes, referral context, enrichment metadata.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: How this contact entered the pipeline (e.g. 'LinkedIn scrape', 'conference', 'referral', 'Apollo batch').

fields.name: City
fields.description: Contact's city — pulled from Apollo enrichment.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Contact's country — pulled from Apollo enrichment.

fields.name: Created
fields.description: Timestamp of record creation (auto-populated by Airtable).

views.name: All Contacts
views.description: Full table view of all contacts.

views.name: Outreach Queue
views.description: Contacts enriched and verified but not yet contacted.

views.name: Replied / Meeting
views.description: Contacts who replied or have a meeting scheduled.

_meta.author: Anix Lynch — gozeroshot.dev
_meta.notes: Use this schema as a reference when manually creating the Airtable base. Airtable does not support programmatic base creation via their standard API — create fields manually or use a third-party tool like airtable-schema-exporter.
